Application and data management project

Pre-School Management System

The problem

Managing learners, teachers, books and borrowing records requires consistent records and a clear administrative interface.

My contribution

My project brings these records into an administrative application with login, a dashboard and create, read, update and delete operations.

Technologies and approach

Admin dashboard, database-backed record management and CRUD workflows. The repository provides the implementation details.

What it delivers

The application combines key statistics and administrative record management in one place.

Current status

Source code is available for review. No live production deployment is claimed here.
